payload.claim: This docstring still enumerates only `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, `APPROVED`, `REBUTTAL_UNJUDGED` and `EXHAUSTED` as the states another row's pull request can carry to block this push, but the guard a few lines below (now reading `{"EXHAUSTED", "CHANGES_REQUESTED", "APPROVED"} | STALE_PUSH_STATES`) also refuses beside a `REVIEW_INCOMPLETE` row. The docstring is therefore an incomplete description of the function's current behaviour. This looks deliberate (the comment directly above the guard was updated to name the full set instead, apparently to avoid growing the docstring past the `prose` gate's line-count ratchet), so a reader who only reads the docstring, not the comment, gets a stale picture of what states are covered.
